title: Design: Saving a default adds its card line and moves nothing sideways
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with no saved Bill Invoices To, so the customer bills itself.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p1-11-before-customer-page.png, bt-p1-12-after-bill-invoices-to-line.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer A's page.
  2. Take a screenshot of the page.
  3. Open customer A's Edit Customer window.
  4. Click the "Bill Invoices To" field.
  5. Pick customer B in the list.
  6. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer A's left card shows no "Bill Invoices To" line.

Step 2:

  • You have a picture of where each heading, field and button sits before the change.

Step 3:

  • Customer A's Edit Customer window opens.

Step 4:

  • The list opens.

Step 5:

  • "Bill Invoices To" reads customer B's name.

Step 6:

  • The window closes; under IBS the left card now shows "Bill Invoices To" with customer B's name and "Change".
  • Every line above the new line is in the same place as in your screenshot.
  • The Contacts and Assets counters keep their left-right place and only move down, below the new line.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12303 (Story 1, Saved default Bill To on the customer page)

  • S1-R1: “When a default other than the customer itself is saved, the customer page left card shows "Bill Invoices To" with the payer's name.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794510417-a68d (its boards are byte-identical to version 1794239066-4906 read 9 Nov 2026), read 13 Nov 2026: pictures "Customer page" (page 1 "Set a customer's default Bill To", Production (v26.45.2.1)), "Bill Invoices To line" (page 1 "Set a customer's default Bill To", This build). Compare the screen with the pictures; the expected results come from the PRD.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • bt-p1-11-before-customer-page.png
  • bt-p1-12-after-bill-invoices-to-line.png

The design's own words:

  • “The card ends with IBS, then Contacts and Assets.”
  • “Under IBS: "Bill Invoices To", "A & J Truck & Trailer Repair", and "Change".”

The design's before and after pictures of the customer page (compared 13 Nov 2026) show the counters pushed straight down by the new line and nothing moving sideways.
